subject: Hosted API eval — quick onboard & sandbox access
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@falken.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2029 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in Hosted API trial — quick eval

Hi Soojin,

I signed up for the Hosted API trial this morning and wanted to schedule a short demo to validate latency and batching behavior for our chat feature. We're looking for a 30-minute walkthrough + sandbox access so our infra lead can run a couple of throughput tests.

Available windows (PT): Tue 6/25 10–11am, Wed 6/26 8–11am. If those don't work we can be flexible. Also looping in our procurement contact (Meera) for any MSA/PO questions.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Chen
Sr. ML Engineer, Falken AI
alex@falken.ai

Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2029 15:12:00 -0700

Hi Alex — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for signing up.

I can run a focused 30-minute eval next week. Two immediate slots on my side:
- Tue 6/25 10:30–11:00am PT
- Wed 6/26 9:00–9:30am PT

If either works I will send a calendar invite and loop in Engineering Ops to provision a sandbox with an API key and a small token budget for throughput tests. If you prefer a Calendly link, here it is: https://cal.redwood.ai/invite/rdw-demo-72

Quick prework (optional): please upload a small prompt set or a short transcript to this folder so I can tailor the demo: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/rdw-falken-prework

Cc'ing Diego from SDR ops to help with sandbox provisioning cadence and Mina from Eng Ops (if needed) — I'll follow up once I have your pick.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Redwood Inference
From: Alex Chen <alex@falken.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Meera Patel <meera@falken.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2029 08:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in Hosted API trial — quick eval

Thanks Soojin — Wed 6/26 9:00–9:30am PT works best for us. Please include Meera on the invite.

A couple of asks before the call:
- Can you provision a sandbox API key scoped to 10k tokens so our infra lead can run a short throughput script?
- We're in a VPC-constrained environment — any guidance on IP allowlist or agent endpoints would be helpful so we can do the tests from our staging cluster.

I uploaded a short prompt set to the Drive link and added a one-pager about our expected QPS.

Appreciate it — Alex
(PS — Meera will handle contract/procurement questions on our side.)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Hi Alex & Soojin — Mina from Eng Ops here.

Sandbox is ready: created an API key scoped to 10,000 tokens and an ephemeral client secret. Attachment: sandbox-credentials.txt (contains API key stub and endpoint).

Notes for your staging run:
- Use endpoint: https://eu1.api.redwood.ai/v1/hosted (we've also enabled us-west region endpoints for lower latency)
- If you need an IP allowlist, reply with the CIDR(s) and we'll add them to the allowlist for the sandbox project (typical turnaround < 2 hours).
- Token limits are soft — ping me if you need a bump for the test window.

I've scheduled the 30-minute demo for Wed, 26 Jun 2029 09:00–09:30 PT and shared the calendar invite: https://cal.redwood.ai/invite/rdw-demo-72

Looking forward to the session.
